description: The line plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for different model ensemble configurations, as evaluated in the PromptMind Team’s EHRSQL-2024 submission on improving SQL generation reliability using ensemble LLMs. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” ranges from 0 to 10 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” spans from 30 to 90, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines at intervals of 20. Three distinct lines are plotted: the blue line with circular markers represents the “3-Model Ensemble,” starting at approximately 82 at cost 0 and gradually declining to about 73 at cost 10. The red line with circular markers, labeled “2-Model Ensemble,” begins near 85 at cost 0 and decreases to roughly 72 at cost 10. The yellow line with circular markers, which lacks a legend label but appears to represent a single model or baseline, starts at 90 at cost 0, drops sharply to about 66 at cost 5, and further declines to approximately 42 at cost 10. All lines show a downward trend, indicating that reliability decreases as cost increases, with the yellow line exhibiting the steepest decline.
